dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric reduction in 2D width from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast linear white marking along the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, bright longitudinal linear scar or marking is visible on the lower dorsal area extending toward the tail region.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a dark, circular aperture on the anterior dorsal surface.
